requirements: Offsets and lengths count UTF-16 code units, not Unicode code points.
Never begin or end inside a surrogate pair; reject an interior start and move an interior end backward.
Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair.
Validate safe integer ranges; allow the empty slice exactly at EOF. Preserve the return fields and do not mutate inputs.
